work_item.role: W1 public-evidence discovery and neutral admission

collection_state.note: No active pass-56 W1 branch was present when this batch was claimed. Issue #93 remains active through the frozen cutoff.

discovery_pass.method: Direction-blind admission of three committed PawBench DeepSeek V4 Pro submission summaries under the source harness labels Hermes, OpenClaw, and QwenPaw. W1 preserves the source score fields and task counters, including the OpenClaw missing-task counter inconsistency, without ranking the harnesses or back-projecting later package pins into the May 29 runs.
discovery_pass.historical_harness_versions: unknown in the May 29 submission artifacts
discovery_pass.evaluator: PawBench automated, LLM-judge, and hybrid grading surfaces; the initial public benchmark uses Claude Opus 4.6 as judge

source_known_dimensions: same PawBench v1.0 benchmark family and 150-task publication surface
same source score field names overall_score, automated_score, and judge_score
explicit_unknown_or_nonidentical_dimensi: historical harness package versions are not bound by the May 29 artifacts
exact DeepSeek V4 Pro serving snapshot and endpoint are unresolved
trial repetitions, random seeds, historical timeouts, and compute budgets are unresolved
OpenClaw artifact reports tasks=150 and tasks_total=150 together with tasks_missing=3

provenance_strength.w1_treatment: admit factual committed source summaries while preserving unknown execution identity and source counter anomalies

protocol_deviations_and_failures.detail: Repository Docker recipes with explicit harness package pins were introduced after the May 29 submissions. W1 does not assign those later versions to the historical runs.
The committed source reports tasks=150 and tasks_total=150 while also reporting tasks_missing=3. W1 preserves all counters verbatim and does not repair the source.

non_admission_dispositions.surface: publisher leaderboard ordering and comparative claims
non_admission_dispositions.reason: W1 preserves source result fields but performs no evaluative ordering or winner selection.

non_admission_dispositions.surface: historical harness versions inferred from later Dockerfiles
non_admission_dispositions.reason: The explicit Docker pins postdate the May 29 result artifacts and cannot establish the versions used in those runs.
